replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
This map could have incredible potential. The idea is really nice, although a couple things:

Too plain. Make more variation in the ground by adding different block textures, paths, more landscaping and terrain. You can also add more structures maybe IN or AROUND the mountains, or anything to help make the place seem more populated (if that's what you're going for). And something else you have to change 100% - the mountains. I can literally tell you just took a world edit brush and circled the maps. Give the mountains more peak, detail, and block variation to make it look cleaner and more official. 

There's more though. If you have any way of creating more space, that would be fantastic, considering the map doesn't look like it could support 40+ people at a time. Also clean up some of those empty spots you've left with the world edit brush at the corners. If you want to keep them there, create a small alcove and create a sharp peaking mountain around it, on each side, which helps the map feel large and extravagant.
